chunks: So whoever repents after his wrongdoing and reforms, then indeed Allah will accept his repentance. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Allah's acceptance of repentance after a sin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked with the preceding verse (5:38) regarding the thief, illustrating that divine mercy is accessible even to those who committed specific crimes, provided they repent before being apprehended. The condition of 'islah' (reform) implies not just verbal regret but a tangible correction of one's state and actions, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of belief and practice. This assurance underscores Allah's attribute of 'Ghafur' (All-Forgiving) and 'Rahim' (All-Merciful), offering hope to sinners who actively seek to realign themselves with divine will.
